; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; Find the boundingbox for non-zero pixels in a mask. ; ; :Categories: ; ; SST pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; Mats Löfdahl, Institute for Solar Physics ; ; ; :Returns: ; ; The boundingbox as [llx,lly,urx,ury] ; ; :Params: ; ; mask : in, type="2d array" ; ; A binary 2d mask. ; ; ; :Keywords: ; ; ; ; ; ; ; :History: ; ; 2024-07-11 : MGL. First version. ; ;- function red_boundingbox, mask xproj = total(mask, 2) yproj = total(mask, 1) llx = min(where(xproj gt 0)) urx = max(where(xproj gt 0)) lly = min(where(yproj gt 0)) ury = max(where(yproj gt 0)) return, [llx, lly, urx, ury] end
